mapper.select: select c.id as customer_id, c.name as customer_name, c.owner_user, u.user_name as owner_name, a.id, ifnull(a.balance, 0) as balance, ifnull(a.frozen_amount, 0) as frozen_amount, ifnull(a.balance, 0) - ifnull(a.frozen_amount, 0) as available_balance, ifnull(a.total_recharge, 0) as total_recharge, ifnull(a.total_deduct, 0) as total_deduct, ifnull(a.total_refund, 0) as total_refund, a.last_flow_time, ifnull(a.status, 1) as status, a.create_time from crm_customer c left join crm_customer_account a on a.customer_id = c.id left join sys_user u on c.owner_user = u.user_id where c.id = #{customerId} and c.deleted = 0
select id, customer_id, balance, frozen_amount, total_recharge, total_deduct, total_refund, version, status, last_flow_time, create_time from crm_customer_account where customer_id = #{customerId}

select id, customer_id, balance, frozen_amount, total_recharge, total_deduct, total_refund, version, status, last_flow_time, create_time from crm_customer_account where customer_id = #{customerId} for update
mapper.insert: insert into crm_customer_account (customer_id, balance, frozen_amount, total_recharge, total_deduct, total_refund, version, status, last_flow_time, create_time) values (#{customerId}, ifnull(#{balance}, 0), ifnull(#{frozenAmount}, 0), ifnull(#{totalRecharge}, 0), ifnull(#{totalDeduct}, 0), ifnull(#{totalRefund}, 0), 0, ifnull(#{status}, 1), #{lastFlowTime}, sysdate())
mapper.update: update crm_customer_account set balance = #{balance}, total_recharge = #{totalRecharge}, total_deduct = #{totalDeduct}, total_refund = #{totalRefund}, last_flow_time = #{lastFlowTime}, version = version + 1, update_time = sysdate() where id = #{id} and version = #{version}
mapper.select: select (select count(1) from crm_customer c where c.deleted = 0 ) as customer_count, (select ifnull(sum(ifnull(a.balance, 0)), 0) from crm_customer c left join crm_customer_account a on a.customer_id = c.id where c.deleted = 0 ) as total_balance, (select ifnull(sum(f.amount), 0) from crm_customer_account_flow f join crm_customer c on c.id = f.customer_id where f.biz_type = 1 and f.create_time >= #{monthStart} ) as month_recharge, (select ifnull(sum(f.amount), 0) from crm_customer_account_flow f join crm_customer c on c.id = f.customer_id where f.biz_type = 2 and f.create_time >= #{monthStart} ) as month_deduct, (select ifnull(sum(f.amount), 0) from crm_customer_account_flow f join crm_customer c on c.id = f.customer_id where f.biz_type = 3 and f.create_time >= #{monthStart} ) as month_refund from dual
select id, customer_id, balance, total_recharge, total_deduct, total_refund, version, status from crm_customer_account
